Maya: Heads-up — planning a slow rollout for the new asset-hash change today. Targeting 18:30 PT. Anyone available for the smoke window? :rocket:
CJ: I can do 18:30 PT. What's the plan for edge caches? We moved to a content-hash path structure so we probably shouldn't need a full invalidation.
Liam: Agreed. Prefer avoiding large CF invalidations. Plan: warm canary slot, route 5%, run smoke tests, then 25/50/100 if green. Set low TTL on canary route.
Sasha: Quick Q — are we bumping service-worker version? If not, clients with old sw may keep stale assets.
Maya: Yes, bumping sw to v3.2. Also will serve /sw.js with Cache-Control: no-cache during the rollout window.
CJ: Can someone paste the exact invalidation cmd we might run as a fallback?
Liam: Fallback command (only if needed):
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E2EXAMPLE --paths "/static/abc123/*" 
```
Maya: @deploy-bot starting preflight checks now.
deploy-bot: preflight OK — build artifacts verified, asset checksums match, foldr manifest sanity OK.
Maya: Rollout plan: 18:30 PT start -> 5% canary -> 10m smoke -> if green -> 25% -> 10m -> 50% -> 10m -> 100%. Rollback rule: revert canary alias if smoke fails or if error rate >1% for 5m.
CJ: Smoke test checklist (manual + script): load homepage, login flow, editor save, image upload. I'll run the automation and paste results to the thread. :white_check_mark:
Sasha: Adding analytics note — new asset ids change heatmap selectors, pinging @data-eng to watch event mapping.
data-eng: Roger — I'll monitor the event stream, verify keys, and flag schema mismatches.
Maya: Ops note: after each step, run these checks from 3 regions:
```
curl -I https://app.redwood.example/static/<hash>/bundle.js
# expect 200 + correct Content-Length and ETag
```
Maya: Also one-off small CF invalidation for `/sw.js` and `/index.html` if any client caching issue shows up.
CJ: I'll be on-call for rollback. Ping @cj in thread and I'll execute alias flip.
Sasha: If anything looks off I'll post screenshots and HAR.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Proceeding at 18:30 PT unless objections. :eyes:
